errors.evidence: The description incorrectly combines the first category label, "Leben", with the general x-axis label, "Zufriedenheit mit dem/der ...". The latter is a general label that applies to all four categories on the x-axis, not part of the name for the first category.
The description repeats the error of incorrectly naming the first category. The bar with the value +0.28 corresponds to the category "Leben", not "Leben Zufriedenheit mit dem/der...".
